# Vendored browser libraries

Copied unchanged from npm so the mock-up needs no CDN and no build step.

| File | Package | License | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.js` | qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (`dist/qrcode.js`) | MIT, Kazuhiko Arase | entry QR on a ticket (`index.html`) |
| `jsQR.js` | jsqr 1.4.0 (`dist/jsQR.js`) | Apache-2.0, see `jsQR.LICENSE` | live door screen (`index.html`) when the browser has no `BarcodeDetector` |
